calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE period_end_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' ORDER BY period_start_date
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl, min(sale_date), max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 'sale' AS kind
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net, 'return'
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'P5' rng, kind, CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'stores' END part, round(sum(net_sales),2) v, count(*) n FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Sep', kind, CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'stores' END, round(sum(net_sales),2), count(*) FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT (s.store_id=999) is999, (p.category='ZZ Test') test, round(sum(f.net_amount),2) v, count(*) n
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE COALESCE(w.dispatch_date,f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')
GROUP BY ALL
